neural.objective: Training-standardized execution-return MSE + .1 * training-standardized 5-bar OHLCV auxiliary MSE
neural.input: Raw 125 observed bars, fixed 25x5 patches; per-window log OHLC/log1p volume normalization, no pretrained tokenizer
neural.runtime: Existing CUDA deterministic float32 environment; TF32 off; four CPU threads; no installations

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.

features: Frozen eval requires_grad=False; 25 flattened decoded coordinates; training 1/99 percent clipping and population standardization with sd floor1e-6. Four R18 market descriptors clipped/scaled separately on same training rows. Supervised R18 coefficient ray[:25] shared by both products. Volatility interaction residualized over R18+intercept; order interaction residualized over R19+intercept. Training least squares rcond1e-12, residual sd floor1e-6. Order uses exact trailing60close signs, mean adjacent product minus permutation expectation; neutral exact zero. R23 jointly refits all coefficients; R25 freezes R19 including intercept and fits only gamma. No full-pipeline OOF claim.
experiment: Prospective incumbent/challenger trial with delayed promotion, and fixed annual-quarterly probability blend

shadow.rule: At each non-December quarterend compare the incumbent with the challenger launched at the preceding quarterend. Use all common actually-issued Friday forecasts since that trial start whose joint_completed<=decision. Require at least8 mature pairedweeks, challenger strictly lower mean Brier AND strictly more correct directions at probability>.5. Otherwise hold; exacttieshold. Same monitor schedule shared by all6methods and3seeds. No search over monitor,minimum,lossgate,margin orcadence.
shadow.issuance: During each quarter freeze the incumbent and challenger, record both forecasts on each signaldate. At quarterend assess only this pair and this just-finished trial, then launch current-cutoff model as NEXT challenger. A promotion selects the already-tested previous-quarter model, never the model just trained today. Decisions only affect signaldate>cutoff; a signal on decisiondate belongs to the previous trial.
shadow.annual: Initial2020-12-31 and every December reset incumbent to newly trained annual model. The new challenger is identical to this incumbent, so March holds with same_model. December ignores trial performance and resets unconditionally. September trials still issue forecasts but cannot override mandatory yearend reset.
shadow.expected_calendar: 23 training dates,6mandatoryresets,17optionalchecks:6Marchsame_model and11potentialJune/Septemberpairdecisions. Atleast8 chosen as minimum evidence within onequarter, not an optimized threshold or a formal significance test.

blend.rule: At every forecastdate use latest strictly-earlier December model and latest strictly-earlier quarterend model. Average their probabilities within the same seed, then equal3seed probabilities. Frequency probabilities samehalfaverage; native raw return forecasts samehalfaverage with zero threshold and no invented probability. In Q1 models identical. No fitted weights, no adaptive routing, no future labels.
blend.cutoff_column: For blend rows cutoff records the latest constituent training cutoff only, not a single trained model. blend_routing.csv records both constituent cutoffs and weights.

limitations: All272historical outcomes and some challenger/incumbent diagnostics were seen before this round; this is exploratory historical requalification, not a new blind test. Gate selected in response to R30 probability/accuracy mismatch; no outcome search within R31. Small trial samples can be noisy and slow; dual gate is a heuristic, not statistical proof. R19 shared schedule may not suit R23/R25. Shadow requires training challengers even when rejected, so no quarterly-training-cost saving claim. Annual reset retained, including bypass of yearend trial.
